# axual_flink_cluster (Resource)

A Flink Cluster registers a Ververica Platform namespace on an Instance-Cluster, so Flink SQL applications can be deployed to it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Ververica namespace-scoped API token. This field is Sensitive and will not be displayed in server log outputs when using Terraform commands.
- `cluster_id` (String) The Uid of the Instance-Cluster this Flink Cluster belongs to.
- `deployment_target` (String) Ververica deployment target name, e.g. `default-target`.
- `instance_id` (String) The Uid of the Instance this Flink Cluster belongs to.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Flink Cluster.
- `namespace` (String) Ververica namespace name.
- `url` (String) Ververica Platform base URL, e.g. `https://vvp.internal/api`.
- `workspace` (String) Ververica workspace name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A short description of the Flink Cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Flink Cluster unique identifier
